sections.label: About
sections.text: Junior software developer with a B.S. in Game Programming and Development (summa cum laude, 4.0 GPA) and hands-on experience building applications in Python, Go, and C#, including backend systems, CLI tools, database-driven architectures, and game development. Background spans big data engineering (Spark, Hadoop, Hive), engine-level C++ in Unreal Engine, and cross-platform tool development in Godot. Comfortable working outside the boundaries of a given framework when the problem demands it. Actively building projects and expanding skills through Boot.dev coursework in Go, SQL, and systems programming. Certified in Python (PCEP) and Neo4j.

items.name: KasaPlugControl
items.description: Cross-platform battery charge controller using TP-Link Kasa smart plugs. Monitors battery level and automatically toggles charging to extend battery lifespan. Ships a persistent system tray icon, Pushover push notifications for critical alerts, a vigilance mode that triggers platform-specific hibernation on unexpected discharge, and an optional multi-cycle calibration mode. Runs natively on Windows, macOS, and Linux.

items.name: Gator
items.description: CLI RSS feed aggregator backed by PostgreSQL. Supports user registration and login, feed subscription management, and configurable automatic aggregation that polls feeds on a set interval. Posts are stored and browsable with a configurable result limit. Installable globally via go install.

items.name: Stadium Rental Suite
items.description: Two-application tournament management system with a shared MongoDB backend. A C# client lets players build and save their team and submit match inputs. A host-facing web app receives those submissions and manages bracket execution. Both apps coordinate through the database with no direct communication channel. Includes a GitHub Pages landing page as a unified entry point.

items.name: Hyperspace Shinies
items.description: Static web reference tool for Pokémon Legends: ZA shiny hunting, live on GitHub Pages. Driven entirely by local JSON data — no backend or build step required. Presents zone encounters with expandable type-coded tiles, live search with autocomplete, and filtering logic that accounts for multi-pool spawn interactions.

items.name: Spinning Wheel
items.description: Streamer-focused tool built in Godot with the bulk of logic in GDScript. Identified that Godot has no native global hotkey support — a hard requirement for a tool used while another window has focus. Integrated a C# global hotkey library and wrote the interop layer connecting hotkey events to the Godot application, working outside the engine's standard toolset to ship a required feature.

items.name: Paintball
items.description: Complete paintball game built in Unreal Engine for a university course requiring all gameplay logic in C++ — no Blueprint editor permitted. Procedurally generated mesh geometry by manually computing vertices, normals, tangents, UV coordinates, and triangle indices for dynamic mesh actors. Implemented a shader-driven countdown effect and a noise-based dissolve effect using dynamic material instances and USF pixel shader files. Architected a full game state machine using a C++ enum exposed to Blueprints, a custom PlayerController class, a UMG HUD widget, and Blueprint-callable hit detection functions.

items.name: Fuzzy Farmer
items.description: Fully realized Unreal Engine game featuring original 3D models and textures created in 3DS Max and Photoshop, procedurally generated trees from Blender, composed background music, and custom foley audio. End-to-end game asset creation from modeling through integration into a real-time engine.

items.name: Team Type Calculator
items.description: Desktop GUI application built in Python with Tkinter to evaluate Pokémon team type coverage and identify weaknesses.

items.name: Password Generator
items.description: CLI tool that generates cryptographically secure passwords with configurable length and character composition. In daily personal use.

items.name: pokedexcli
items.description: Go CLI REPL that queries the PokéAPI over HTTP to retrieve and display game-area encounter data, with stateful session management across commands. Built as part of the Boot.dev curriculum.

items.name: Static Site Generator
items.description: Python tool that converts Markdown documents into a complete static HTML site. Generated site deployed and live on GitHub Pages. Built as part of the Boot.dev curriculum.

items.name: AI Agent
items.description: Python AI agent working with external API calls and structured response handling. Built as part of the Boot.dev curriculum.

items.name: Asteroids
items.description: Recreation of the classic Asteroids arcade game built in Python using Pygame. Built as part of the Boot.dev curriculum.

items.title: Package Handler
bullets: Process packages in a high-volume warehouse environment while maintaining accuracy, speed, and safety.
Demonstrate consistent reliability and performance in physically demanding, time-sensitive operations.

items.title: Preloader
bullets: Loaded and organized packages for time-sensitive delivery routes in a fast-paced morning operation.
Maintained efficiency and attention to detail while working under strict deadlines.

items.title: Senior Associate
bullets: Earned the Neo4j Certified Professional credential through independent self-directed study of graph data modeling and Cypher query writing.
Earned the PCEP certification from the Python Institute through dedicated self-study.
Provided project support including Jira ticket management and issue tracking in an enterprise environment.

items.title: Software Associate
bullets: Completed 400 hours of big data engineering training covering Scala, Spark, Hadoop, HDFS, and Hive.
Built a Scala CLI application performing CRUD operations on JSON data to manage user and game state.
Contributed to a team Spark project analyzing real COVID datasets, calculating per-location daily case changes and growth factors.
Deployed Spark jobs to AWS cloud infrastructure.
Used Hive to analyze sample datasets and answer scenario-based business questions.
